character: A broad short woman of sixty, thick forearms, a grey braid wound round her head and pinned with a fork, a burn scar across the back of one hand. A loud open laugh.
wardrobe: A brocade waistcoat buttoned wrong over a linen shirt, sleeves rolled, a leather apron, a ring of keys at her belt.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing behind a bar counter made from a ship's rail, a slate drinks board behind her.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Leaning on the bar of a crowded tavern inside a ship's hull, lanterns overhead, a storyteller standing on a table behind her, laughing at someone off frame.
